title: Ella Langley, Wham!, Mariah Carey & More: Highlights of This Week’s Billboard Charts
summary: All of Billboard’s charts update each Tuesday.
contentText:
Tuesday is new Billboard chart day each week! As all charts update each Tuesday, here’s a look at highlights of the latest rankings, dated Nov. 21 and reflecting the Nov. 6-12 measurement week, according to data tracker Luminate.

Among this week’s chart stars are Ella Langley, Olvia Rodrigo, Lil Baby and P1Harmony.

Plus, as a trip to the supermarket reflects (eggnog is sold near milk, so it’s healthy, right?), the holiday season is here. It’s clear on the Billboard Hot 100 , too, where Wham!’s 1984 classic heads up eight carols. Here’s a rundown:

- No. 14 (up from No. 37), “Last Christmas,” Wham!

- No. 18 (up from No. 39), “All I Want for Christmas Is You,” Mariah Carey

- No. 28 (reentry), “Jingle Bell Rock,” Bobby Helms

- No. 30 (reentry), “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” Brenda Lee

- No. 32 (debut), “Take Me Home (4 Christmas),” Olivia Rodrigo

- No. 43 (reentry), “Santa Tell Me,” Ariana Grande

- No. 45 (reentry), “Underneath the Tree,” Kelly Clarkson

- No. 47 (reentry), “It’s the Most Wonderful Time of the Year,” Andy Williams

It’s especially notable that “Last Christmas” is the top-ranking holiday hit so far, as it reached a No. 2 Hot 100 high last year, below “All I Want for Christmas Is You,” which ran up its total to 22 weeks at No. 1.

Meanwhile, Rodrigo’s single dashes in following its Nov. 6 release . It’s her first career holiday song.

On the Billboard 200 , Michael Bublé has the highest charting seasonal album, as Christmas , from 2011, vaults 119-35.
